thread:
ryan-sales: Hey team — starting POC with AcmeHealth next Tue. Need a billing project/org + POC creds. Requirements: $5k free credits applied, enforce $2,000 spend cap, quota cap for Hosted API (60 rpm, 100k tokens/day), temporary API key that expires in 30 days. Also need Dedicated preview enabled and note that this will move to Private/VPC with KMS later. Who can provision?

maria-se: I can coordinate the presales checklist. Quick Q: is this HIPAA/BAA? If so we need the security questionnaire answered and VPC/KMS sooner.

ryan-sales: Yes HIPAA — sales flagged BAA required. They want to start on Hosted keys while legal works on BAA, then migrate to VPC.

devon-ops: I can create the org and billing project. Plan: 1) create org `acme-poc-2026` 2) apply credit note for $5k 3) set spend cap $2,000 (enforced) 4) set quotas (60 rpm, 100k tokens/day) 5) generate temp API key tagged `acme-poc-hosted` with 30d expiry. I’ll need customer contact email + PO#.

alex-eng: For Dedicated: we can flip on a `dedicated-preview` flag to give them reserved capacity on our shared pool while SOW completes. Private/VPC will require network CIDR, peering method (VPN/Direct Connect), and KMS key ARN. Also callout: token scoping — create a scoped key so it can't touch other dedicated projects.

billing-bot: Invoice placeholder created: INV-2026-0432. Credit applied: CRED-POC-5K (pending final PO).

maria-se: Action items: @devon-ops create org + credit, @alex-eng enable dedicated-preview, @ryan-sales collect PO and CIDR/KMS info, I'll fill security questionnaire answers and upload. Reference: https://docs.redwood.ai/billing#spend-caps

ryan-sales: PO is coming today. Can you also create a console invite for their admin and scope the API key to read/write generation only?

devon-ops: Will do. Creating org and key now. Example internal commands I ran:```
# create org + billing project
billing-cli create-org --name acme-poc-2026 --owner ryan@redwood.com --project acme-poc-2026
# apply credit note
billing-cli apply-credit --org acme-poc-2026 --credit-id CRED-POC-5K
# create scoped API key (masked output)
redwood-cli keys create --org acme-poc-2026 --scopes generation:write,generation:read --expires-in 30d --tag acme-poc-hosted
```

sre-bot: :white_check_mark: org acme-poc-2026 created. Quotas set: 60 rpm, 100k tokens/day. Spend cap set: $2,000. Temporary API key created and masked as `key_hst_poc_57a` (will be rotated in 30 days). Console invite sent to provided contact.

maria-se: I uploaded initial security questionnaire draft to the shared drive and marked questions that need legal input. Note: Dedicated access requires SOW + infra ticket for VPC peering. Also ensure API key scope `dedicated:acme-poc` is created when we flip dedicated preview.

ryan-sales: Thanks — I forwarded customer PO# PO-987654 and emily@acmehealth.com for the invite. They prefer Hosted start and will share CIDR + KMS ARN by EOD.

devon-ops: Invites sent to emily@acmehealth.com and cc'd ryan. Role `poc-admin` created (console + API). KMS integration pending until we get ARN. Key rotation scheduled at T+30days.

maria-se: I'll finish the security questionnaire answers and ping legal about the BAA. Once SOW signed we'll convert the org to Dedicated or initiate Private/VPC onboarding.

ryan-sales: Great — please keep me posted. Closing thread after SOW. :thumbsup:
